'''Raichlings'''<ref name="Ewoks sub">{{Ewoks|Malani the Warrior}} {{Subtitles|Disney+}}</ref> were a large snail-like [[Species/Legends|species]] which existed on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. They lived in mud, which they were able to slide across. They were also able to communicate with [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], as [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] asked several Raichlings to allow him and his friends to ride on their backs across a sea of mud in the native [[Raichling language]]. The Raichlings appeared to be on friendly terms with the Ewoks, as they gladly accepted Teebo's request.<ref name="EwoksMalanitheWarrior">{{Ewoks|Malani the Warrior}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Raichlings appeared in the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] episode "[[Malani the Warrior]],"<ref name="EwoksMalanitheWarrior" /> which was originally broadcast on [[December 13]], [[1986]].<ref name="Insider27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref> The spelling of the species' name was first revealed in the [[Disney+]] subtitles.<ref name="Ewoks sub" />
